name: Rock Paper Scissors
tagline: Interactive web-based game featuring dynamic DOM state updates and computer move algorithms.
description: Responsive browser implementation of the classic Rock Paper Scissors game, engineered with pure JavaScript logic, dynamic score tracking, and smooth visual outcome transitions.
problem: Simple browser games often suffer from clunky event handling, layout shifts on state updates, and an absence of persistent session scorekeeping.
solution: Built a fast, lightweight web game that calculates game-theory outcomes against an automated computer opponent, featuring real-time DOM manipulation and animated victory/defeat states.
metrics_and_highlights: Implemented game loop evaluating user moves against randomized computer algorithms.
Integrated persistent score tracking updating dynamically without page refreshes.
Engineered responsive UI controls with interactive hover effects and visual outcome banners.
Optimized with lightweight, zero-dependency vanilla web standards for instant load times.

gameplay_and_logic_engine: Conditional decision matrix resolving win, loss, and draw game states
Pseudo-random move generator simulating an automated opponent
Dynamic session scoreboard maintaining win-loss streaks
interface_and_interactions: Interactive choice buttons featuring click animations and selection highlights
Dynamic DOM status cards displaying chosen moves and round verdicts
One-click game reset controls reinitializing score states
